censoring: Preserve all final reference receipts including failures; missing END recorded as right-censored, not zero/completed; exclude only unavailable labels from prediction error denominators and report them
cohorts: actual optimizer consumption of latest same-occurrence delivered POSITION
families: map × scenario, 6 families; three disturbances per family
input: Same actual paid capture, delivered END history before capture, original nominal, START-relative capture/current age, position and delivery time for every mode
labels: Actual future END minus capture/current time only; END never a feature of its current occurrence
primary_metric: descriptive family/world/row MSE at accepted active delivery; also MAE, bias, per-family/per-world and capture/consumer scores
reference_selection: Exactly one final registered reference trajectory per each of the 18 worlds; no other policy trajectories
scope: Secondary prediction evaluation; primary complete scheduling outcomes retain priority
timing: Registered after main scientific matrix started and after all model freezes, before reading new scientific episode values
weights: family then eligible world then row equally; publish world/row coverage and zero-query worlds
